objective: Run reproducible finalist comparisons and select one direction or reject both.
actions: Added a public-API comparison script for recall identifiers and federal-rule keywords
Tested full and truncated model proxies against the official CPSC description search
Tested a fixed public-rule profile and assessed whether independent relevance validation was possible
Selected the recall screener and recorded its problem contract
hypothesis: One finalist can demonstrate an objective, reproducible action advantage using public inputs alone.
result: supported for recall retrievability; contradicted for federal relevance advantage
checks: Executed experiments/run4_compare.py successfully against live official APIs
Verified 14/14 full and partial recall target retrievals and recorded unique versus ambiguous results
Validated experiments/run4_results.json and RUNS/run-004.json as JSON
Confirmed one selected candidate and four rejected candidates
limitations: The recall labels are proxies extracted from recall image captions, not photographs supplied by resellers.
Exact identifier search is already available from the official CPSC API, so this test establishes automatable triage, not superiority over manual search.
The federal profile is synthetic and keyword expansion is not an independent relevance judgment.
No review-time improvement or real reseller-label accuracy has yet been measured
next: Implement the minimal conservative recall-intake CLI and tests.
